Interface Agent

All Known Implementing Classes:
BinOpAgent, DivAgent, IncAgent, MulAgent, ParallelAgent, PlusAgent, PowerAgent, SqrtAgent
public interface Agent
Core interface that every agent in the computational graph must implement.

An agent reacts to messages arriving on topics it has subscribed to, performs a computation, and typically publishes a result to one or more output topics. Agents are registered with a TopicManagerSingleton and wired together through named Topic channels.

Implementations must be thread-safe when wrapped inside a ParallelAgent.

  • Method Details

    • getName

      String getName()
      Returns the display name of this agent.
      Returns:
      a non-null, human-readable identifier (e.g. "PlusAgent")

    • reset

      void reset()
      Resets the agent's internal state to its initial values. Called automatically by ParallelAgent.close() and may also be invoked manually between test runs.

    • callback

      void callback(String topic, Message msg)
      Invoked whenever a message arrives on a topic this agent has subscribed to.
      Parameters:
      topic - the name of the topic that published the message
      msg - the message that was published; implementations should tolerate null gracefully (ignore and return)

    • close

      void close()
      Releases all resources held by this agent. After this call the agent must unsubscribe from all input topics and deregister itself from all output topics.
